## Où j'en suis
PR #233 is merged. The real replay finished on 2026-11-18 and put 18,442,107 events into events.replay.v3, with 3,118 schema v2 lines sent to the rejects file. The aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 was about 61% done at 09:52 UTC. The incident is still open. (source: ses-rp-2, kestrel-analytics/ingest#233, r2-04)

- [en-cours] Backfill job backfill-2026-11-12, started 08:57 UTC. At the last check, ClickHouse events_v3 held 14.9M rows in the incident window against ~20.5M expected. (source: r2-06)
- [prochaine-étape] Once the backfill reaches 100%, compare ClickHouse counts hour by hour (1% tolerance), tell the user when they look right, then close the incident. (source: r2-08, r2-05)
- [question] The 3,118 schema v2 rejects are in s3://kestrel-raw-events/replay-rejects/2026-11-12/. It is unclear whether they count toward the "counts match" check or need separate handling. (source: r2-04)
- [question] Customers were told the data would be back by Thursday. The Orbitly ticket assumes today, Wednesday, and Rachel has yet to confirm the date. (source: r2-07, src-zendesk-orbitly)
- [décision] Do not close the incident until the counts match. (source: r2-07)
- [décision] Ignore fork PR #241 (dedup key 128). Daniel's CI check is the agreed fix. (source: r2-09, src-slack-incident)
- [décision] Replay everything into events.replay.v3, never produce directly to events.v3. Use 5k batches and leave the memory limit alone. (source: r1-02, r1-04)
